sections.text_helper: Section 40.6.12 "TAMP backup x register (TAMP_BKPxR)" in chapter 40 (Tamper and backup registers (TAMP)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1621.
sections.section_content:
This register can be protected against unprivileged access. Refer to Section40.3.6: TAMP
privilege protection modes.
Address offset: 0x100 + 0x04 * x, (x = 0 to 31)
RTC domain reset value: 0x0000 0000
System reset: not affected
Bits 31:0 BKP[31:0]:
The application can write or read data to and from these registers.
In the default (ERASE) configuration this register is reset on a tamper detection event. It is
forced to reset value as long as there is at least one internal or external tamper flag being
set. This register is also reset when the readout protection (RDP) is disabled.
